status.title: Status
status.description: ISSUES_FOUND when any checked file has missing or empty fields, NO_ISSUES_FOUND when every checked file is complete, NOT_CHECKED when no file could be checked.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Plain-text results with one line per file, including the reason when nothing could be checked. Relay this to the rep.

filesChecked.title: Files Checked
filesChecked.description: Number of files that were checked, whether or not issues were found. Files reported as NOT_CHECKED are not counted.

filesWithIssues.title: Files With Issues
filesWithIssues.description: Number of checked files that have at least one missing or empty field.

files.title: File Results
files.description: Per-file results, newest file first: file ID, name, type, check method (Parsed or AI review), status, missing fields, empty fields with locations, and a note explaining anything not checked.
